title: pick and omit for plain objects
prompt:
Can you add `pick(obj, keys)` and `omit(obj, keys)` to src/object.js, exported next to the existing helpers? `keys` is an array of property names.

- `pick` returns a new object containing only the listed keys that are own enumerable properties of `obj`, in the order they appear in `keys`. Keys that `obj` doesn't have are ignored (not added as `undefined`), and so are inherited and non-enumerable properties. A key that exists with the value `undefined` is kept.
- `omit` returns a new object with every own enumerable string key of `obj` except the listed ones, in the original key order. Listed keys that don't exist are ignored. Inherited and non-enumerable properties are not copied.

Neither function may mutate `obj` or `keys`, and both always return a new object, even when nothing is picked or omitted.
acceptance: pick keeps listed keys in keys order, ignores missing/inherited/non-enumerable keys, keeps explicit undefined; omit drops listed keys, keeps order, copies only own enumerable; inputs unchanged and results are new objects.
difficulty_rationale: Two short functions; the only subtleties (own vs inherited, enumerability, no mutation) are stated.
